sentences.text: Author: Manoj Kumar Tiwari Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari

Office Notes,
 reports, orders Sl. or proceedings  Date COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS No. or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  WPMS No. 3607 of 2023  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
(1) Mr. Sachin, learned counsel for the petitioners.
(2) Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
(3) Mr. Naresh Pant, learned counsel for the respondent/NHAI.
(4) Petitioners' land was acquired by National Highway Authority of India for construction of National Highway.

According to him, Competent Authority Land Acquisition has determined compensation amounting to 10,85,45,542/-, as payable to petitioner, therefore, he has sought a direction that the amount of compensation, as determined by the Competent Authority Land Acquisition, be directed to be released.

(5) Mr. Naresh Pant, learned counsel appearing for NHAI submits that order/award passed by Competent Authority Land Acquisition has been put to challenge before Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of National Highways Act.
(6) Since the award has put to challenge before Arbitrator, therefore, no direction can be issued to the Competent Authority Land Acquisition.

(7) Accordingly, writ petition is disposed of with a direction to Arbitrator to pass order, as per law,
under Section 17 of the Arbitration & Conciliation Act, within four weeks from today.

(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 15.02.2024 Aswal WPMS/3607/2023 on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45388940/
